# Env packages on macOS (read by setup). Everything is built from the env recipes; the system
# provides none of them.
#
# [build]: the packages setup builds (with their dependencies) when run without arguments. The
# order does not matter: each recipe builds its dependencies first.
# [system]: packages the system provides. They are never built, and a recipe's dependency on one
# does nothing.

[build]
flac
freetype
freetype-noharfbuzz
gettext
glib
harfbuzz
libffi
libiconv
libmpeg2
libpng
libsamplerate
libuuid
mpg123
openssl
portmidi
python
sdl3
sdl3_image
sdl3_ttf
sqlite
xz
zlib
zstd

[system]
